baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive جُمِعَ governs the coordinated nouns ٱلشَّمْسُ and ٱلْقَمَرُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scattered-parts branch of ج م ع treats the two separately named sky bodies as components forced into one collected configuration; the passive presents the resulting convergence while leaving its agent unstated.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into a collected whole supplies the focus verb's concrete coalescing operation.
The sun-and-daylight branch identifies one component as the actual solar luminary.
The moon-and-moonlight branch identifies the second component as the actual lunar luminary.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are merely listed together under a generic gathering verb.
changed_reading.after: Two independently located luminaries are made into one collected celestial configuration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جُمِعَ joins the sun/daylight term and the moon/moonlight term in one passive event.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wholeness branch of ج م ع combines not only two objects but the complementary illumination regimes carried by their branches, yielding an image of celestial allness without remaining separation.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without scattering or loss turns the gathering into totalization rather than simple proximity.
Sun and daylight supply the bright daytime regime being totalized.
Moon and moonlight supply the nocturnal illumination regime being totalized.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports the meeting of two astronomical objects.
changed_reading.after: The verse compresses the full pair of celestial light regimes into an undivided totality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The eventive passive جُمِعَ can activate concentration of force or motion around the two luminaries.
baseline_models.mechanism: The force-gathering branch makes the event kinetic: formerly separate solar and lunar motions are concentrated until they arrive together, rather than resting in a neutral side-by-side arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Gathering force or motion until concentrated supplies acceleration and convergence to the passive event.
The solar body supplies one moving celestial participant in the concentration.
The lunar body supplies the other celestial participant drawn into the same concentrated event.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is a static conjunction of sun and moon.
changed_reading.after: Gathering is a concentration of celestial motion or force that drives both bodies into one event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جُمِعَ is applied to two named celestial participants, while its gathering-place, gathering-day, and summons branch remains available.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch recasts the passive as convocation: the sun and moon are not only put together but summoned as participants to an appointed cosmic assembly.

activation_trace.role: A gathering-place, gathering-day, or summons gives the focus event an appointed convocation structure.
The literal sun becomes one summoned celestial participant.
The literal moon becomes the other summoned celestial participant.

changed_reading.after: The bodies are called into an appointed cosmic convocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeats ج م ع for bodily bones, the sun and moon, and the collected recitation. Capacity supplies effective agency, while ق ر ء itself contributes an image of collection and joining. The focus event therefore becomes a macro-scale instance of reconstituting dispersed parts into a coherent whole across body, cosmos, and discourse.

activation_trace.role: The focus verb's scattered-parts-to-whole image anchors cosmic reassembly.
Wholeness without loss makes completeness, not mere proximity, the result of the focus gathering.
The same gathering image applied to bones supplies an explicit bodily precedent for reconstitution.
The same scattered-to-collected image applied to the recitation extends reassembly into discourse.
Effective capacity to perform and possess an act supplies the ability behind the repeated reassemblies.
The reading root's own collection-and-joining image makes gathered discourse structurally parallel to gathered bodies and luminaries.

structural_cues: The exact root ج م ع occurs at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 in the order body, cosmos, discourse.
The first-person agency around bodily and recitational gathering makes the focus passive's omitted agent newly salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated gathering across bones, luminaries, and recitation plus effective capacity; I infer one reconstituting operator across those domains. A live alternative is rhetorical parallelism without an identical process or necessarily identical explicit agent.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon undergo an isolated astronomical convergence.
changed_reading.after: Their convergence is the cosmic-scale instance of a repeated power that reassembles dispersed matter and discourse into complete wholes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sun/daylight and moon/moonlight partition a recurring temporal order, but the focus gathers them under the wholeness branch. The surrounding contrasts of a bounded day, what is advanced and delayed, and preference for the immediate while leaving the later sharpen this into temporal closure: differentiated times are compressed into one comprehensive present of reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without scattering turns the two time-marking lights into one exhaustive temporal totality.
Sun and daylight supply the daytime side of the temporal alternation.
Moon and moonlight supply the nocturnal side of the temporal alternation.
A duration of time frames the surah's named Day as an encompassing temporal interval.
Advancing forward supplies the earlier or sent-ahead side of the temporal record.
Deferral to a later time supplies the delayed or left-behind side of the record.
Hastening and bringing forward literalize the immediate term that humans prefer.
Leaving something behind supplies the rejected later term whose postponement the focus gathering closes.

structural_cues: The paired lights in 75:9 sit inside a surah repeatedly marked by يَوْمَئِذٍ and a named Day.
The paired constructions in 75:13 and 75:20-21 oppose ahead/behind and immediate/later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies daylight, moonlight, duration, advancement, delay, immediacy, and leaving-later; I infer that gathering the sky's alternating timekeepers closes temporal spacing. A live alternative is that the moral time contrasts do not describe the physical function of the celestial event.

changed_reading.before: Gathering totals two celestial objects or light sources.
changed_reading.after: Gathering abolishes the postponing intervals they mark, collecting ahead and behind, immediate and later, into the single Day now present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence first fixes or startles sight, then subtracts from the moon, then gathers moon with sun. Because the two focus nouns carry daylight and moonlight, their collection reads less as additive brightness than as collapse of the alternating contrast by which vision distinguishes a world.

activation_trace.role: The collected-whole image brings the two distinct sources of illumination into one configuration.
Sun and daylight provide one pole of the visual contrast.
Moon and moonlight provide the other pole of the visual contrast.
The staring or transfixed gaze makes perceptual failure the first step of the local sequence.
Literal eyesight identifies the faculty disrupted before the luminaries are gathered.
The branch's image of diminishment makes the moon's preceding event a subtraction rather than an added light.
The repeated heavenly moon links its diminished state directly into the focus gathering.

structural_cues: 75:7-9 forms an uninterrupted sequence of sight, lunar diminishment, and celestial gathering.
The moon is repeated in adjacent ayat, so its condition in 75:8 carries directly into 75:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transfixed eyesight, diminution, repeated moon, daylight, and moonlight; I infer that the gathering removes useful visual contrast rather than summing brightness. A live alternative is a physical conjunction whose effect on illumination is left unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon become jointly visible in one place.
changed_reading.after: Their gathering collapses the alternating light contrast that makes ordinary seeing and orientation possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The convocation branch of ج م ع is followed by flight denied, refuge absent, sovereign lordship, a fixed settlement, and later driving. The gathered luminaries thus mark a system-wide closure of routes: even the sky's great bodies converge under the same compelled movement toward one terminus.

activation_trace.role: The gathering-day, place, or summons branch turns celestial collection into convergence at an appointed terminus.
Flight and escape supply the route the post-focus question seeks and cannot secure.
The refuge branch supplies the shelter explicitly negated after the celestial gathering.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the authority at the single terminus.
Fixity and settlement make that terminus stable and non-escapable.
Driving and herding supply the compelled directional motion that culminates at the terminus.

structural_cues: 75:10-12 immediately answers the celestial event with escape, no refuge, and one settlement.
75:30 repeats the direction to the Lord but now names the movement as a driving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a summons image, denied escape and refuge, sovereign settlement, and driving; I infer that the sky's gathering visibly enacts the same closure imposed on humans. A live alternative is that it is only one sign preceding, rather than mechanistically sharing, the human convergence.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon meet at an unspecified celestial location.
changed_reading.after: Their gathering is the cosmic sign that every route has closed and all participants are being driven to one sovereign settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus syntax binds two named counterparts under one passive predicate. Later, separation turns immediately into one thing wrapping another and bodily counterparts meeting under a drive; the creation sequence then names a pair whose members are joined as mates. This activates gathering as imposed pairing: distinct cycles and identities remain legible, but autonomy is removed by a shared fate.

activation_trace.role: The collected-whole image binds the separately named celestial counterparts under one event.
The literal sun supplies the first member of the celestial counterpart pair.
The literal moon supplies the second member of the celestial counterpart pair.
Distinguishing and separating two things supplies the counter-state that the subsequent bindings reverse.
Wrapping one thing upon another supplies an image of counterparts made inseparable at the bodily level.
The literal leg or shank branch grounds the repeated bodily counterparts joined in the construction.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the surah's explicit pair-making image.

structural_cues: One passive verb governs two coordinated celestial nouns in 75:9.
75:28-30 moves from separation to bodily wrapping and driving, while 75:39 explicitly forms a two-member pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, wrapping, repeated bodily counterparts, driving, and pair formation; I infer a recurrent move from independent members to an imposed pair. A live alternative is that the bodily and generative pair images do not map onto the celestial coordination.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a neutral conjunction of two luminaries.
changed_reading.after: The verse imposes one fate on two counterparts, binding their formerly independent cycles without erasing their distinction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the ayah's grammar as an enacted mechanism rather than only a report of cosmology. It remains anchored in the single predicate joining two nouns, the repeated ج م ع of 75:17, and the packet's collection/reading/disclosure branches. Downstream prose should present it as a formal or metapoetic resonance, not as a replacement lexical sense of جُمِعَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single passive predicate جُمِعَ grammatically collects ٱلشَّمْسُ and ٱلْقَمَرُ into one coordinated clause.

activation_trace.role: The scattered-to-collected branch describes both the reported event and the clause's formal joining of two names.
The same collection image applied to the recitation makes verbal gathering a live contextual parallel.
Collection and joining within the reading root links gathered wording to gathered content.
Reading and recitation make the collected clause an audible performance rather than only a static arrangement.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign makes the performed gathering revelatory in form.

changed_reading.before: The line only reports that two celestial bodies will be gathered.
changed_reading.after: The line also performs a miniature gathering by collecting both luminary names under one recited passive predicate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the retained-pregnancy image belongs to a peripheral ج م ع usage and the focus verb need not carry it directly. It remains worth carrying because the focus gathering is anchored in that packet branch and the surah closes with semen, attachment in the womb, creation, and paired sex. Downstream prose should say the event may evoke gestational compression before re-creation, never that جُمِعَ lexically means pregnancy here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive جُمِعَ supplies compression into one held state, while a focus inventory branch associates ج م ع with retained pregnancy or intactness.

activation_trace.role: The retained-pregnancy or intactness image supplies the exploratory notion of a whole held inward before emergence.
Semen from which form is apportioned supplies the initial compressed potential in the closing creation sequence.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies retention and attachment before formed creation.
Bringing creation into existence supplies emergence from the retained state.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the paired result that echoes the gathered celestial pair.

changed_reading.before: The celestial gathering is only terminal collapse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a compressed, retained pairing poised before another act of formation or re-creation.

strongest_changes: Repeated ج م ع turns 75:9 from an isolated conjunction into the cosmic instance of a reassembly operator spanning bones and recitation.
The sun/daylight and moon/moonlight branches, activated by the surah's temporal oppositions, turn celestial collection into closure of ordinary temporal postponement.
The immediate sight and lunar-diminishment sequence changes a potentially bright conjunction into collapse of usable visual contrast.
Denied escape and refuge, fixed settlement, and driving turn the gathering into compelled convergence on one sovereign terminus.
Later separation, wrapping, and pair formation preserve a distinct reading of the sun and moon as counterparts bound to one fate.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the same compact clause participate in several nonexclusive mechanisms: material reassembly, temporal and perceptual collapse, jurisdictional closure, counterpart pairing, and a formal gathering performed by recitation itself.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus passive does not name its agent, so linking it to the explicit first-person gathering elsewhere is strong but still inferred.
The packet does not decide whether celestial convergence physically cancels illumination or merely places the bodies together.
The later bodily, generative, and textual structures may be deliberate cross-domain echoes or reader-supplied analogies rather than direct specifications of 75:9.
